correctness.rationale: For every d>=2 and fixed 0<a<ell, the centered body is C+[-a/2,a/2]1. A.e. partition into a central delta-cube and d swept positive facets has Jacobian one, central mass delta/(delta+da), wing masses a/(delta+da). Integrating central and special-wing coordinate products proves zero mean, diagonal/offdiagonal covariance and the two stated eigenspaces exactly. The determinant combined with volume delta^(d-1)(delta+da) yields (12L^2)^d and the fixed-parameter limit d log(12L²)+log d→2. Coupling all but a singled-out wing index proves TV error (delta+ka)/(delta+da); conditional iid uniform CLT proves the empirical-mean Gaussian fluctuation. Independent 44 exact rational tile/moment/determinant profiles agree. The central+wing sampling is measure-uniform; finite checks do not establish the all-d or CLT claims.
